events.description:
🌟 Kouga Business Forum presents: Chris Yelland – Energy South Africa 🌟
We’re proud to welcome Chris Yelland, one of South Africa’s leading energy analysts and MD of EE Business Intelligence. 
Join us for an evening of insight into Future Pathways for South Africa’s Energy – Balancing Nuclear, Solar and Beyond.
📅 4 June 2026 | 18h00
🏨 Humansdorp Hotel, Alexander Street
💼 R150 per person | Free for paid‑up members
🍴 Includes finger eats
🍹 Cash bar available
👉 RSVP by 2 June – WhatsApp or call Louwreen at 082 940 2989
💳 Bank Details for EFT:
Kouga Business Forum – FNB Account nr: 62051994947
Branch code: 210515
Reference: Energy + your name & surname
📧 Please send proof of payment to office@kougabusinessforum.com
✨ Join us for this powerful evening that will shape the energy conversation in Kouga and beyond!
